hero.eyebrow: Founder & CEO · Three O'Clock Coffee & Tea · Vietnam
hero.subtitle: Building a 24/7 café chain for the hours the world forgets — from a single shop in Ho Chi Minh City to four countries.

story.heading: The hours between midnight and dawn
paragraphs: I started working in a café at twelve — my family's café. That early exposure to the rhythms of food, service, and people shaped everything that came after. Long before any formal training, I understood how a café actually breathes: the early rush, the quiet afternoon, the customers who linger.

In 2016, I founded Three O'Clock Coffee & Tea in Ho Chi Minh City — built around a simple but contrarian insight. The hours between midnight and dawn are underserved, and the customers who stay past 3 a.m. are the most loyal kind. So we stayed open while everyone else closed.
story.pull_quote: My path into entrepreneurship was self-directed from the start. Formal study wasn't the foundation of my expertise — nine years of building, operating, and expanding across four countries has been.
paragraphs_after: Since founding the company, I've led every dimension of it: product, brand, operations systems, franchise documentation, partner selection, and international expansion. The entries into India, Indonesia, and the GCC were structured and negotiated directly by me — and the whole network has been founder-led and bootstrapped to date, grown through disciplined systems rather than outside capital.

Beyond operations, I write and speak about what building an F&B business actually looks like — the processes, the mistakes, the unit economics. The content is practical, not inspirational. The goal has always been the same: to build a business that runs without the founder being the bottleneck.

venture.heading: Three O'Clock, by the numbers
venture.closing: The innovation isn't the product — it's the model: a 24/7 specialty café format serving the late-night and overnight market, a segment systematically underserved across Vietnamese and broader Asian F&B. Making it viable meant reengineering staffing, supply chain, and customer experience for a non-standard operating window — then proving it could be replicated internationally.

items.title: The family café
items.text: Working in my family's café through school — learning operations, customer behavior, and the economics of food service from the inside.

items.title: Three O'Clock is born
items.text: Founded the 24/7 café concept in Ho Chi Minh City as a full-time commitment — Vietnam's first café chain built for the overnight hours.

items.title: @thuandaily on TikTok
items.text: Started sharing the behind-the-scenes of running a growing chain — operations, franchising, the unglamorous parts. Now 68K+ followers; top video 436K views.

items.title: Going international & industry recognition
items.text: First franchise entry into India. Appointed Head of Communications at VFLN. Franchise specialist Nguyen Phi Van takes equity in the brand — a credible third-party validation of the model. Named to TOP 10 Top Vietnamese Brands & TOP 10 Prioritized & Trusted Vietnamese Brands.

items.title: Indonesia, a book, and the stage
items.text: Franchise launch in Indonesia. Published 7 Ngày Học Kinh Doanh F&B. Lead instructor at FranA Masterclass (HCMC & Da Lat). Spoke at VIETRF, the Vietnam Franchise Summit, and Vietnam CafeShow. Signed an expanded India agreement at Franchise India 2025, Delhi — the only Vietnamese F&B brand present.

items.title: The Middle East & new honors
items.text: GCC franchise agreement signed, with locations in development. Received the Outstanding Leadership Award and Resilient & Intelligent Entrepreneur recognition, amid continued national media coverage.

cards.title: A 24/7 chain across four countries
cards.text: Scaled from a single café to 23 locations in Vietnam, India, Indonesia, and the GCC — entirely founder-led and bootstrapped, with no institutional investment.

cards.title: Vietnam's first 24/7 café export
cards.text: Signed and executed the first international franchise agreements for a 24/7 café concept — India (12 locations), Indonesia (2 locations), and a GCC agreement now in development.

cards.title: The only Vietnamese F&B brand in Delhi
cards.text: Signed an expanded India franchise agreement at an official ISFA conference ceremony, witnessed by ISFA leadership — the sole Vietnamese F&B brand represented.

cards.title: A franchise specialist takes equity
cards.text: Nguyen Phi Van — one of Vietnam's most prominent international franchise specialists — took equity in Three O'Clock in 2024, a credible signal of the model's scalability.

cards.title: Featured on VTV3
cards.text: Interviewed on-camera at the Three O'Clock exhibition booth and broadcast to a national audience on Vietnam's Channel 3.

cards.title: Exhibiting worldwide
cards.text: Represented the brand at international trade exhibitions in Shanghai, Dubai, the Philippines, India, and Vietnam across 2024–2025.
